source.observer: tsc-rs parse_config_root_plan, recorded by the fixture test's observe() (the removed-option rows follow tsgo program.go verifyCompilerOptions "Removed in TS7" at the vendored commit)
source.verification: tsgo built from the vendored commit (scripts/typescript7.py build, Version 7.1.0-dev), run as `tsgo -p <config> --pretty false` on each case's materialized files on 2026-10-02: every config-level row's file, line, column, code and message chain compared (lengths are not printed by tsgo; the recorded lengths are the config parser's property-name and value spans). Result on 2026-10-02: 63 of 76 cases identical (the 13 others: tsgo maps an explicit `classic`/`node10` moduleResolution to the default resolution). The same comparison on 2026-10-09, after the ts71-removed-module-resolution slice made the port map them the same way and re-recorded those 13 rows: 76 of 76 cases identical.
